messages:
release-bot: Quick weekly release-train snapshot and freeze guidance for the coming 72h. TL;DR: We’re entering a soft freeze for non-critical feature merges starting 2024-06-05 18:00 UTC; security/infra hotfixes and critical bugfixes are exempt but require approvals listed below. Please read all the notes and follow the rollout gating checklist.

ana: Thanks — couple clarifications: what counts as a critical bugfix?

kumar: Critical = P1/P0 production incidents (user-facing failures, data loss, security). Anything else needs a freeze-exemption. If in doubt ping @ops-oncall and include the canary plan.

sophie: Rollout status: canaries running for v3.4.1 on eu-west-1 and us-west-2, 12h in, error budget steady. No perf regressions so far. I'll post the canary logs to the release dashboard.

ops-oncall: If you need a freeze exemption, please: 1) create a short PR description, 2) add label `freeze-exempt`, 3) @ops-oncall + @release-bot in the PR, and 4) include a one-paragraph rollback plan. Typical approval cadence: SRE lead + release manager.

maria: Heads-up — we have one pending infra migration (KV cache compaction tweak) that *must* go before the freeze window or it will block the Reserved GPU autoscaler. Targeting a pre-freeze merge by 2024-06-05 12:00 UTC. Ops will coordinate if we need an exemption.

ana: Small ask — can we extend canary to 24h for the embeddings path? Volume spike predicted tomorrow.

sophie: I can extend the canary for embeddings to 24h in eu-west. Will monitor latency percentiles and KV hit-rate. If we see >5% P95 increase, we pull the rollout.

kumar: Reminder: deploys to Dedicated must follow the dedicated-deploy checklist (link: https://intranet.redwood/release/checklists/dedicated). We’ll enforce gating during the freeze window; failures without an approved rollback plan will be rolled back automatically by the deploy-bot.

ops-oncall: Quick command snippets for exemption reviewers: ``` /approve-freeze-exempt PR-1234 --reason "hotfix: token-serialization-bug" ``` and please add the audit tag `freeze-2024-06`.

release-bot: Final notes: documentation updates are exempt from the freeze but please avoid schema changes. If you merge something late and it affects canaries, escalate immediately. Will post a follow-up summary at 2024-06-06 09:00 UTC with final canary readouts and any exemption decisions. :mega: :shield:

maria: acked. I’ll coordinate the KV compaction target and post status.

ana: thanks all — very clear. I'll hold non-critical patches until the freeze lifts. :white_check_mark:

sophie: posting canary dashboard link in #release-dashboard now.
